# FoliageLayer

- Inherits [`Instance`](instance.md)
- Created with `Instance.new("FoliageLayer")`

Where foliage grows over a terrain (ADR 0116): grass, flowers, stones, bushes -- drawn and never simulated. Its `FoliageMesh` children say what grows; its rules say where, by the ground's material, slope and height, never under a roof. **Visual only**: nothing collides with it, a raycast passes through it, it is not replicated and it is not in the world hash -- every machine grows the same field from the same terrain and seed.

**Members below are the ones this class DECLARES.** Everything its base
offers is on the base's page, which is what keeps one added member on
`Instance` from being a change to every page here.

## Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Access | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Clumping` | `number` | `0` | read/write | How much it gathers into patches, from 0 to 1: 0 is even cover, 1 is tufts with bare ground between. |
| `Density` | `number` | `2` | read/write | How many instances a square metre of ground holds where every rule allows it, before the material's multiplier, the painted mask and `[render] foliage_density` scale it. |
| `DrawDistance` | `number` | `120` | read/write | How far from the camera it is drawn, in metres. Past it nothing of the layer costs a draw. |
| `Enabled` | `boolean` | `true` | read/write | Whether it grows at all. Off hides every instance of it, and nothing is placed. |
| `FadeDistance` | `number` | `20` | read/write | Over how many metres before `DrawDistance` it thins away, so the edge of the field is not a line. |
| `HeightMax` | `number` | `10000` | read/write | The highest ground it grows on, in metres: a tree line. |
| `HeightMin` | `number` | `-10000` | read/write | The lowest ground it grows on, in metres of world height. |
| `MinSpacing` | `number` | `0.25` | read/write | The least distance between two instances, in metres. |
| `ReceivesDecals` | `boolean` | `true` | read/write | Whether a `Decal` paints what it grows. On, a mark laid on the ground is on the grass that stands in it too, whichever way a blade faces -- a blade takes the picture as the ground under it does, where a part's own side is left clean. Off for what should stand clear of every mark: a decal paints round it and under it, as it does a part with `BasePart.ReceivesDecals` off. |
| `Seed` | `number` | `0` | read/write | Which of the endless arrangements the same rules give. The same seed grows the same field on every machine. |
| `SlopeMax` | `number` | `35` | read/write | The steepest ground it grows on, in degrees: grass thins out before a cliff does. |
| `SlopeMin` | `number` | `0` | read/write | The flattest ground it grows on, in degrees from level. |

## Methods

### `GetMaterials(): { { Material: number, Density: number } }`

The terrain materials it grows on, each with a multiplier of `Density`: material `n` is the terrain's layer `n` (`Terrain:GetLayers`). Empty is every material at 1.

### `SetMaterials(materials: { { read Material: number, read Density: number? } })`

Sets the materials it grows on, as `GetMaterials` returns them: up to 32, `Density` 1 when left out. An empty list grows on every material. Saved with the scene.
